# Refactor report — actual scope and evidence

## Scope and Authority

Original task/readiness, request/mode source and study-only/local/broad disposition;
approved roots/write paths/exclusions, protected dirty baseline. Actual source/
parent/feature links and validated identity/anchors. No implicit expanded permission.
Human consequential decision or full DAO/hybrid bounded guidance; human and hybrid
require human completion/route confirmation. Actual human CR
authority before intentional behavior/acceptance/constraint change, not invented.

## Goal / Subgoal Quality and Preservation

| Goal / Subgoal | Parent / Source | Stakeholder | Contribution / Selection | Baseline | Success Evidence | Preservation / AC / Type | Trade-off | Outcome State |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| {stable internal enabling goal or source US; inferred when justified} | {source/parent anchor/revision} | {maintainer and credible indirect beneficiary} | {all-required branches or selected alternative and rationale} | {inspected actual before structure/method} | {named measured or concrete qualitative comparison, not score} | {public behavior/results/errors/data/constraints and stable GWT AC/type} | {accepted cost/uncertainty and rejected means} | {not measured or actual cited observation; separate from delivery} |

## Analysis and Sync

Actual tool output including scope/quality/suggestions/principles/report/errors,
or disclosed scoped adapter with exact non-invocation, omitted full-tool gates and
rationale. Inspected versus authorized dependencies. Missing/not_found artifacts
remain gaps. Study read-only, local affected references/targeted tests, broad
justified integration/full suite/measurement; no blanket global 80% prerequisite.
No spec rewrite to bless code deviation, failing-test skips or fabricated scores.

## Preservation Baseline

Approved public APIs/imports/re-exports, outputs/errors/data/side effects and
caller/security/concurrency/resource boundaries as implicated. AAA scenarios and
unchanged assertions; actual commands/exits/results/source/test/config hashes.
Baseline failures and unavailable evidence explicit. No invented bug/red gate.

## Plan and Trade-offs

Named goal → inspected gap → selected principle/structural means → exact phase/
paths → preservation tests → after comparison. All-required coverage, bounded
alternatives, source authority and affected docs/Change Log. Restore only owned
prework bytes after checking concurrent changes, never foreign dirty work.

## Execution

Study recommendations without source/test/doc mutation except authorized report,
or actual enabled sequential operation refactor outputs. Skill-package target
uses creator complete candidate/review/publication gates. Real changed paths/counts,
assert-level results, lint/errors and failures; no fictional tool invocation,
actual feature allocation, inline production fallback or automatic Git commits.

## Before / After Evidence

For each named quality goal: comparable method/scope, inspected baseline and actual
after comparison, preserved behavior checks and trade-off. Study is recommended,
not achieved improvement. Designated score strings may be not measured; no synthetic
metric or numeric-schema sentinel. Applicable coverage must be actually measured;
unmeasured is not maintained. Preserve existing tracing/redaction; disabled/absent
requires no forced setup. Final actual domain tests/build/lint and broad applicable
integration/full suite, failures/limits and current evidence/review hashes.

Engineering delivery: actual verified fixture/artifact/domain checks or pending.
Stakeholder outcome: not measured unless actual cited stakeholder observation.
Changed revisions invalidate affected evidence only; unrelated IDs/history retained.
Independent review: actual record or pending. Candidate_ready is not published.

## Actual Workflow Disposition

Free-mode no app write. Workflow-mode actual code_refactor remains mandatory until
verified integration changes; required tech-design/specification, optional test-report,
predecessors/feature context and actual refactor-report file. Conditional owner
write/readback only after genuine completion; study is not fake done/skipped.
Writer acceptance does not prove readiness or report existence.

## Original Output and Owner Handoff

Preserve entry's entire original category/status/conditional next skills/nested
process_preference/execution_mode/workflow.name/links/feature_id/refactoring_summary/
code_quality_evaluated and supplied legacy/dynamic fields; no alternative output
schema here. Actual counts/paths/principle applications/goals/coverage/reference
counts, exact tool operation_output and pertinent blockers. Unmeasured coverage
uses actual null sides/status with report reason, not declaration placeholders or
false maintained status. Strict consumers rejecting null are a compatibility gap;
see integration. Missing required measurement blocks its claim only.
One owner handles lifecycle/authorized boundary; no child board/Git/app/successor.
